tools.name: list-networks
tools.description: Every proof-of-stake network BitBasic covers: its slug (the "network" argument of the other tools), token, kind, what it calls a validator, and its dashboard. Start here when you don't know a network's slug.

tools.name: network-status
tools.description: One network now: its health, where it is in its epoch, the active validator set, total stake, typical fee and other figures its dashboard leads with, as BitBasic last read them.

tools.name: network-parameters
tools.description: One network's rules as its chain states them: unbonding time, active set size, minimum commission, slashing, governance quorum and thresholds, inflation, fees and the rest, each in plain words, with recent changes. Read from the chain every hour.

tools.name: find-validators
tools.description: Validators and staking providers whose name, address or operator matches a query, on every network or one: exact addresses first, then by stake. Use it to find an operator's validators (such as "Chorus One") or which network an address is on.

tools.name: list-validators
tools.description: A network's validators, sorted as its dashboard sorts them (by stake on most networks) or by another figure, each with its status, stake, uptime, commission and delegators' reward rate.

tools.name: validator-details
tools.description: One validator in full: status, stake, delegators, commission and its delegators' reward rate, how much it signed and produced, its last 100 blocks (where the network says who signed each), and how it voted on the latest governance proposals. Find its address with find-validators.

tools.name: compare-validators
tools.description: Two to four validators on one network side by side: status, stake, uptime, commission and what their delegators earn a year, as BitBasic's compare page shows them.

tools.name: estimate-staking-rewards
tools.description: What delegating earns on a mainnet, as BitBasic's rewards calculator works it out: the yearly rate for any validator or a chosen one (after its commission), and for an amount, what it earns per day, month, year or a number of days. An estimate from today's rates, without restaking, not a promise or

tools.name: governance-proposals
tools.description: Governance proposals on one network or every one: the latest, those in one status (open for votes, opening soon, passed, rejected, other outcomes), or one proposal in full with its text, tally and (on Cosmos networks) how each validator voted.

tools.name: decentralisation-report
tools.description: How concentrated a network's stake (and, where it has them, its staking providers) was over a month: the Nakamoto coefficient, the top 10's share, HHI and the active set, at the month's end, with its range and the change from the month before, from BitBasic's hourly readings.

tools.name: latest-news
tools.description: BitBasic's latest news posts (upgrades, governance, advisories, reports), on every network or one, newest first, each with its summary and link.
